externalMechanicFamily.finding: Documented IGT Golden Egypt variants collect persistent coins above reels; two coins on a reel can make that reel fully wild for the next two paid spins. In cabinet implementations the visible coin/wild state can be inherited by a following player and can create variable-state advantage opportunities.

decisionLogic.whyPriorityRaised: The exact Betfair Spain deployment is still present and Betfair currently reports a realized return above 100% for Golden Egypt. This is a triage signal only; realized return is not theoretical RTP and cannot prove future edge. The known variable-state family makes served-state verification worthwhile.
greenOnlyIf: exact served provider/build binds current Betfair golden-egypt-aem to the documented variable-state implementation
help/rules or passive pre-wager observation confirms the coin/wild state mechanic
visible state can be read before any wager
state persistence/scope is proven for the exact online build rather than assumed from physical cabinets
configuration-specific EV for the observed state is computed and conservative lower bound exceeds 100%
